scopedPhysicalReadback.scope: Only canonical installed GUI file metadata/hash and exact AppCompat value; no process launch

confirmedFacts: Both original GUI PE manifests request requireAdministrator.
Neither authenticated original cleanup helper includes an AppCompat or RUNASINVOKER override.
Historical 3.7.8 source commit 5df9a59 and tag v3.7.9 write ~ RUNASADMIN in HKLM/HKCU for both registry views; v3.7.8 tag is absent.
Physical installed authenticated 3.7.9 has ~ RUNASADMIN in all four scoped AppCompat values and no __COMPAT_LAYER environment override.
Native baseline restoration and actual Core recovery readback succeeded before both old GUI processes failed.
Chromium sandbox result 18 means SBOX_ERROR_CREATE_PROCESS; actual CreateProcessAsUserW GetLastError is separate.
3.7.8 fails without the persistent-cache sharing error seen in 3.7.9; cache lock does not explain the shared failure.
inferences: requireAdministrator with restricted GPU tokens on Windows Server is a plausible environment-sensitive cause, supported by a historical first-hand Electron Builder reproducer; not established as this run exact root cause.
Missing NSIS RUNASADMIN/shortcut/ARP state makes the restored fixture incomplete, but there is no evidence adding it cures restricted GPU process creation.
unknowns: Actual underlying Win32 last_error from the failed GPU CreateProcessAsUserW call.
Actual runner EnableLUA, ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin, FilterAdministratorToken and process TokenElevationType/integrity/session/desktop.
Runtime Layers values and process __COMPAT_LAYER on the failed runner.
Whether byte-for-byte old GUI works on a compatible disposable Windows desktop with faithful original registrations.
Compiled original Setup NSIS bytecode registration instructions were not decompiled; source tag recipes and physical readback agree but are separate provenance.

preconditions: Existing standard disposable hosted/admin/clean guards pass; exact old payload and canonical executable authenticated.
Resolve genuine x64 CDB/WinDbg and Microsoft symbols; record tool identity/hash/version. Availability is not assumed.
Read UAC/token/session/desktop/AppCompat/environment metadata and preserve pre/post executable hashes. No postmortem-debugger or IFEO registry registration.
method: Launch the original canonical GUI under CDB with the same application arguments/environment/working directory; debugger switches precede executable, no sandbox/GPU/elevation override switches are passed to the GUI.

At initial break resolve the actual OS CreateProcessAsUserW symbol/forwarder via x advapi32!*CreateProcessAsUserW* and x kernelbase!*CreateProcessAsUserW*. Use ba e 1 hardware execution breakpoint at actual API entry, not software bp.
At entry record PID/TID, x64 RDX application and R8 command-line text bounded to 4KiB. Select the authenticated same executable command containing --type=gpu-process; record return address poi(@rsp).

Set a one-shot hardware execution breakpoint at that return address scoped to the same user-mode thread with the documented ~Thread ba syntax; continue with g. Do not use gu, software return breakpoints, target-code writes, DLL injection or calls inside target.

On that exact return before next caller instruction, capture EAX and !gle for the same thread; if EAX=0, this is the native last error immediately following the actual GPU CreateProcessAsUserW failure. Record bounded stack/module/thread attribution, then clear own hardware breakpoints.

Fail closed on unresolved symbols, missed API return, mismatched thread/target, timeout or missing LastError. Stop only owned diagnostic processes through the existing bounded cleanup; record the diagnostic independently and rerun ordinary undebugged GUI/UIA/helper acceptance after remediation.
limits: Debugger changes timing and creates a debugged process; it is diagnostic evidence only, never GUI/helper acceptance.
Only processor debug registers are used for breakpoints; signed old file and instruction bytes are not patched.
Actual runner launch failure has not yet been captured with this procedure. Error 18 alone does not prove Win32 740, 5 or 1314.
Any debugged successful child also does not prove a normal child succeeds; ordinary acceptance is mandatory.
nativeLastErrorDiagnostic.note: Unexecuted debugger alternative to capture actual GPU caller lastError if needed later; no CDB installation was performed or is currently proposed for dispatch. The implemented sampled native boundary helper is the immediate next diagnostic.

exactNextActions: Parent runs the frozen diagnostic source in a genuine disposable hosted job after authenticated full old payload restore and explicitly recorded original ~ RUNASADMIN layer restoration; obtain/export the actual suspended-launch receipt.
Read native UAC/token/AppCompat and per-call immediate error with stage attribution. Do not relabel it as the actual Chromium GPU lastError.
Run the same ordinary unchanged old GUI/UIA/Telegram/original-helper upgrade gate; keep failures and old clean Setup unavailability recorded.

If the ordinary old GUI still fails, use a genuine disposable Windows desktop x64/UAC environment or a separately approved actual-GPU hardware debugger capture; keep real host identity and unchanged old binary/sandbox policy.
No release/old GUI/helper acceptance until the normal native gate actually completes.
